title: Desk Rule — Reckoning the Hours of a Controls Upgrade from the Covered Controllers' Generation
content:
# Desk Rule — Reckoning the Hours of a Controls Upgrade from the Covered Controllers' Generation

**The rule.** Where the covered controllers of a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans are of a generation at least four years newer than the oldest the tier supports and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one software update applied to the covered system, the hours are reckoned at the head-end allowance plus a quarter of an hour — 0.25 of an hour — for each panel the plan covers. Where the covered controllers are of a generation at least four years newer than the oldest the tier supports and the twelve months to the handling day carry no software update applied to the covered system, the hours are reckoned at the head-end allowance plus half an hour, that is 0.5 of an hour, for each panel the plan covers and a further half hour for each whole hundred points the plan covers. In every other case the hours are reckoned at the head-end allowance plus one hour — 1 hour — for each panel the plan covers.

| Generation of the covered controllers | Software updates applied to the covered system in the twelve months | Hours reckoned |
|---|---|---|
| at least 4 years newer than the oldest the tier supports | at least 1 | the head-end allowance plus 0.25 of an hour for each panel covered |
| at least 4 years newer than the oldest the tier supports | none | the head-end allowance plus 0.5 of an hour for each panel covered and a further 0.5 of an hour for each whole hundred points covered |
| fewer than 4 years newer | any number | the head-end allowance plus 1 hour for each panel covered |

## Points of judgement

- The generation margin is met where the covered controllers' model year is at least the tier's oldest supported generation plus 4 years; a controller generation of 2016 at a tier supporting 2012 and older meets it exactly.
- The further half hour for each whole hundred points arises only in the second row.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A plan covering 12 panels and 1560 points, whose covered controllers are of generation 2018 at a tier whose oldest supported generation is 2014, with one software update in the twelve months, is reckoned at the head-end allowance plus 12 multiplied by 0.25, that is 3 hours of panel time. With no software update, it is reckoned at the head-end allowance plus 12 multiplied by 0.5, that is 6 hours, plus 15 whole hundreds of points multiplied by 0.5, that is a further 7.5 hours.
